children: USD.AI has scheduled a CHIP supply unlock for October 2027. The release will make at least 147.12 million tokens available to investors and team members, an amount equal to 7.36% of the circulating supply.
The release is part of CHIP's monthly vesting schedule. The unlock does not trigger sales on its own. Once the vesting restrictions lift, recipients can sell the newly unlocked tokens.

title: USD.AI: CHIP unlock releases at least 147.12 million tokens - Oct 2027
